tools.name: list_listings
tools.description: The listings this connection can edit, newest first, with their ids.

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: The latest edits on a listing (by the owner's agents), with changeIds for undo.

tools.name: undo_change
tools.description: Undo one change by its changeId. Only the parts nobody has edited since go back.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Add a listing photo, logo or headshot to the account from an https link (JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 25 MB) or base64 (up to about 3 MB of file). Returns a storageId for add_photos, replace_photo, set_logo or set_headshot.

tools.name: get_confirmation
tools.description: The state of a request that needed confirmation: pending (waiting for a yes), running, done or failed, with what happened.

tools.name: confirm_action
tools.description: Runs an action that is waiting for confirmation (it uses a credit, or publishes). It needs the credits (or publish) permission on this connection; without it the owner confirms the action in Keylight.

tools.name: start_listing
tools.description: Starts a NEW listing video. Takes the address (or a name for a listing with no public address) and, when the person has one, their public listing page link (Zillow, Redfin or a brokerage page), whose photos and facts Reel-E imports. An idempotencyKey, reused on retry, returns the same draft every ti

tools.name: add_listing_photos
tools.description: Adds photos to a draft: photos attached in the chat (where the app supports it), the photos the listing link import found (useImportedPhotos), files uploaded with request_photo_upload (uploadIds, up to 12), and/or https image links (urls, up to 12 per call). JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 25 MB each.

tools.name: request_photo_upload
tools.description: For a photo file on the assistant's own machine: returns an uploadUrl. The file's bytes are PUT there with the returned headers within 10 minutes, and the uploadId then goes to add_listing_photos.

tools.name: set_listing_basics
tools.description: Optional choices before start_video: the song (a musicId from list_songs; default is Reel-E's first library song), branding ("saved" uses the account's saved brand kit, "none" has no contact card or logo; default is the saved kit when there is one), videoPhotoCount (how many photos the video uses, u

tools.name: list_songs
tools.description: The songs a new listing video can use, with their musicId, tempo and energy.

tools.name: start_video
tools.description: Makes the video for a draft. It creates the listing and uses one of the account's listing credits, exactly like making it in the Reel-E app. A connection that may create listings starts it now and gets the listingId; any other connection gets an approveUrl for the account owner, who approves it in R

tools.name: get_listing_status
tools.description: Where a draft or a listing is: collecting, awaiting_owner, declined, processing, ready or needs_attention. Pass draftId (it reports the listing once started) or listingId. waitSeconds (up to 25) holds the answer until something changes. A video usually takes a few minutes.

tools.name: get_listing_links
tools.description: Links for a listing: its page in Reel-E (watch and download the video there), the editor, and the public website once it is published (publish_website). Downloads: request_download.

tools.name: get_edit_summary
tools.description: The current edit as structured text: every shot in play order (photoId, room, what it shows, length, speed, movement, AI+), transitions, music (tempo, sections), opening title, text, stickers, branding, voiceover and credits left. Most edits start from the photoIds and positions it lists.

tools.name: watch_video
tools.description: Looks at the actual shots with vision and answers a look-and-feel question: pacing, mood, what a shot shows, which shot is strongest. Slower than the summary, so it suits questions the summary cannot answer.

tools.name: review_revision_notes
tools.description: Takes the person's notes that point at times in the video, like 'at 0:28 a weird blur with the plant and the blue chair' or 'at 0:33 remove the older gentleman', passed in their own words. Notes without a time work when the words name the shot ('drop the closet shot'). It finds the shot or transitio

tools.name: check_revision_notes
tools.description: Where the latest revision notes stand: each note's fix, whether it was made, and how the re-check judged it (fixed, better, not fixed). A note counts as fixed only when this says so.

tools.name: list_music
tools.description: Existing tracks this listing can use (the royalty-free library and the person's own uploads and earlier generated tracks), with tempo (BPM) and length. It lists existing tracks only; a new original track is made with request_music_generation.

tools.name: propose_music
tools.description: Shows one existing track (an id from list_music) for the person to play and approve in Reel-E's editor (set_music applies a track directly). Changes nothing until they approve. Several calls in one step offer several options, each with its own reason tied to this listing. Not for generating a new tr

tools.name: browse_options
tools.description: The product guide: every option the Studio has for one area, in the Studio's own words, generated from the same lists the editor uses (title designs, text, stickers, camera and timing, transitions, music styles and trimming, voices, photo edits and staging, branding, formats, plans) plus how_to_choo

tools.name: suggest_direction
tools.description: Takes a wish about how the video feels or looks rather than a named edit: slow, boring, flat, more energy, like TikTok or Reels, too fast, too busy, calmer, more luxury, make it pop, or a look missing from the photos (dusk, a night shot, a season, a Just Listed sign, a reveal). It reads the edit sty

tools.name: get_listing_analytics
tools.description: The listing website's analytics over a period: visits, visitors, video plays, how much of the video people watch, inquiries (leads) and top traffic sources. The full chart is in the listing's analytics in Reel-E. Owner visits are not counted.

tools.name: get_seller_update
tools.description: Everything the agent needs to update the home seller: the live links (website, video), where to download the video, and a ready-to-send message draft with the latest numbers. It sends nothing; the agent copies or sends the message themselves.

tools.name: get_mls_kit
tools.description: Whether the hosted MLS video link is on and ready, the copy-ready MLS fields (video link, address, price, facts, description) and step-by-step posting guidance. It comes before enable_mls_link.

tools.name: update_property_details
tools.description: Changes the listing's facts in Property details: price, bedrooms, bathrooms, square feet, listing status (active, coming soon, pending, sold), the listing description or the listing name (what the opening title shows when its wording is listing_name, for example 'Just Listed in Austin'; it is also t

tools.name: reorder_shots
tools.description: Set the full play order. List every current shot exactly once.

tools.name: move_shot
tools.description: Move one shot to a 1-based position in the video.

tools.name: remove_shots
tools.description: Take shots out of the video. They stay in the listing library and can come back. The video keeps at least 3 shots.

tools.name: add_shots
tools.description: Put library photos (listing photos not in the video) into the video, at a 1-based position (default: the end). The plan's photo limit applies.

tools.name: set_shot_length
tools.description: How long shots stay on screen. Cuts land on the music's beats, so length is shorter (half), normal or longer (double). The first and last shots have set lengths: a shorter first shot while the opening title is on, or a shorter ending, comes back as a choice for the person (remove the title or an end

tools.name: set_shot_speed
tools.description: Playback speed of the camera movement: slow (0.5x), normal or fast (2x).

tools.name: set_movement
tools.description: Standard camera movement for shots. An AI+ shot plays one gentle push-in and has no move to choose, so it is skipped; if every named shot is AI+ the tool refuses. It does not remove AI+ from a shot.

tools.name: find_framing
tools.description: Looks at shots with vision and works out a frame that keeps a subject in view for Wide, Square or Phone. A subject can be given ('the pool and the front door'), or left empty to frame each shot around its main subject. Returns a ready frame for each shot, which frame_shot accepts as frames; a shot w

tools.name: frame_shot
tools.description: Chooses which part of a shot's photo each version shows: Wide (16:9), Square (1:1) or Phone (9:16). Uses no credit; undoable. A version's framing is its own: framing Phone leaves Wide and Square alone. There are four ways to frame, one per call: (a) focusX, focusY (0 to 1, where in the photo the fra

tools.name: set_transition
tools.description: The transition after a shot: cut, speed_ramp or dissolve. Not available before the last shot or next to an AI+ shot. After the first shot it is available only while the opening title is off (the title plays over that whole shot); with the title on, it comes back as a choice for the person.

tools.name: set_fades
tools.description: Turns the video's fades on or off: videoIn (fade in from black at the start), videoOut (fade out to black at the end), musicIn and musicOut (the music's fade in and out). Off leaves the video's length unchanged: the last frame or end card holds instead of going to black, and the music stops with the

tools.name: set_music
tools.description: Turns the music off (musicId null), or switches to a track the person has already heard and approved, including one of this listing's generated tracks (list_generated_music). A new track goes through propose_music so the person can hear it first. Cuts re-sync to the new beat, and a track the person

tools.name: list_generated_music
tools.description: The tracks generated for this listing, newest first, with each name, when it was made, tempo and which one is playing. Suits going back to an earlier generated track; set_music takes the id (or propose_music lets the person hear it first).

tools.name: read_music_structure
tools.description: The playing track's structure laid against the video's cuts: BPM and bar length, the sections (intro, verse, chorus, bridge, outro and so on) with song and video times and loudness, the drop (where the full sound returns), separately when the beat comes in, the part of the song the video plays, and

tools.name: set_pace
tools.description: Makes the edit faster paced, slower and more cinematic, or back to normal, as one undoable change. By default (amount a_little) every other shot takes a half-length or double-length beat-aligned step; amount a_lot steps every shot, for much faster or much slower. A shot whose length or speed was alr

tools.name: set_edit_style
tools.description: The video's edit style, the same switch as the Music panel's: cinematic (the default, today's edit), flow (Flow: a push and an orbit each bar to the drop, then Boomerangs on the beat; AI+ is off in Flow and its clips come back in cinematic) or fast_cuts (Fast Cuts: a cut on every beat after the drop

tools.name: trim_music
tools.description: Chooses which part of the song plays: startSeconds and endSeconds in SONG time (read_music_structure lists the sections in song time), at least 0.5 seconds apart and with at least two downbeats between them; either one alone moves only that edge and keeps the other where it is. For 'end on the last

tools.name: align_first_cut_to_drop
tools.description: Starts the song at the point that makes the video's first cut land exactly on the drop (checked with the Studio's own timing, within one frame); later cuts stay on the beat grid. It uses the drop read_music_structure reports, by trimming the song's start (the person's own uploaded or generated track

tools.name: set_music_volume
tools.description: How loud the music plays under the narration, as a percent (0 silent to 100 full), the same slider as the Voiceover panel. It changes the mix only while narration plays; without narration the music plays at full level. Uses no credit; undoable. Keylight has no fade-in or fade-out control for the mus

tools.name: set_title
tools.description: The opening title card over the first shots: whether it shows, its DESIGN (the same designs as the Text panel's design buttons; browse_options title_designs shows what each looks like), WHICH WORDS it shows (the address, or the listing name, like the Text panel's Address / Listing name switch), whic

tools.name: add_text
tools.description: Add a text overlay for a time range (seconds, 0.1s steps, at least 1s). At most 8.

tools.name: update_text
tools.description: Change an existing text overlay (textId from the edit summary).

tools.name: remove_text
tools.description: Remove a text overlay.

tools.name: add_sticker
tools.description: Add a badge like "Just listed" or "Open house". open_house, price_reduced and a few others take one short line (e.g. "Sat 1-4 PM").

tools.name: remove_sticker
tools.description: Remove a sticker.

tools.name: set_captions
tools.description: Turn narration captions on or off. Needs a voiceover with audio.

tools.name: set_contact_card
tools.description: The end contact card: on or off, the agent's details, and the line above the name (prefix: default presented_by, none removes the line).

tools.name: set_logo
tools.description: Turn the logo end card on or off, or use an uploaded logo (attachment storageId).

tools.name: set_headshot
tools.description: Use an uploaded headshot (attachment storageId) on the contact card, or null to remove it.

tools.name: add_photos
tools.description: Add photos the person attached (attachment storageIds) to the listing and, by default, to the video at a 1-based position (default: the end).

tools.name: replace_photo
tools.description: Swap a shot for an attached photo (attachment storageId), in the same place with the same length and movement. The old photo stays in the library.

tools.name: list_ai_versions
tools.description: Every AI+ version saved on one shot (natural motion and VFX), newest first: its number, what made it (the prompt or the VFX), which one plays now, whether it fits the shot's current length, and how the person rated it. Switching to a saved version uses no credit (use_ai_version); a new one uses 1 AI

tools.name: use_ai_version
tools.description: Switches an AI+ shot to one of its saved versions (a number from list_ai_versions). Uses no credit; undoable. A version made for a shorter spot can't fill a longer shot; a shot without AI+ gets it with request_ai_plus, which reuses a matching saved version without a new credit.

tools.name: request_ai_plus
tools.description: Generates cinematic AI motion for one shot (moving water, fire, people, trees). The camera on an AI+ shot is one gentle push-in, so there is no camera move to pick or describe; the prompt names what should move in the scene. Uses 1 AI+ credit once approved. On a Full control connection it starts at

tools.name: apply_effect
tools.description: A one-tap VFX on one shot: dusk (day to twilight), staging_fill (an empty room furnishes itself; interiors only), seasons (season_from current or a season, season_to summer, fall, winter or spring), shadows (a sun time lapse), stars (a starry night), sign_drop (3D letters drop onto the lawn: sign_te

tools.name: regenerate_ai_version
tools.description: Makes a new AI+ version of one shot for 1 AI+ credit, once approved: a VFX repeats its effect and options; natural motion repeats its prompt unless a new one is passed. version is the saved version to repeat (a number from list_ai_versions; default: the one playing now). The new version lands on the

tools.name: request_ai_seamless
tools.description: AI Seamless is one continuous generated camera move from a shot into the shot right after it, steered by an optional prompt: walking through a doorway, turning from one view of a room to another (a 90 or 180 degree turn between two photos of the same space), flying from an aerial down to the front d

tools.name: request_photo_edit
tools.description: Edit one listing photo: how it looks or what is in it. enhance (brighter, sharper, better color), declutter, twilight (dusk or night look, lights on; interiors too), day (daytime, blue sky), stage (virtual staging in a style) or custom (describe the change in instructions: remove or add an object, s

tools.name: request_music_generation
tools.description: Generates a new original instrumental track for this listing, the same as Create in the Music panel. It suits a request for a new, custom, original or generated track, with the style that fits best (the person says yes before it runs) and a short direction: mood, instruments, pacing, tied to this li

tools.name: read_narration_script
tools.description: The narration script as it stands, part by part: each part's shots and seconds, its exact words, how many words it holds against what its shots fit, whether a voice has recorded it (and whether the words changed since) and whether the narration is in the video. Read it before recording so the person

tools.name: draft_narration
tools.description: Lays out the exact words the person typed or dictated ('say: Welcome to 12 Oak Lane...') over the shots as the listing's draft script, in the Voiceover panel, without spending anything. The person's words go in play order, one part per shot or pair of shots, as written; a part with more words than i

tools.name: apply_narration
tools.description: Puts the recorded narration into the video, or takes it out (enabled false). The person normally does this with Apply in the Voiceover panel after hearing it; this tool covers a request in words ('turn the narration on', 'put it in', 'take it out'). While a voice is still being recorded it is queued

tools.name: request_voiceover_script
tools.description: Keylight's script writer for any narration or voiceover request ('add a voiceover', 'write narration', 'rewrite the script'), the same as Generate auto voiceover in the Voiceover panel: it watches the video and writes a script timed to the shots. Uses 1 script generation once approved (the reply say

tools.name: edit_narration_section
tools.description: Changes the words of one part of the draft script (section: its 1-based number in the Voiceover panel, or its id), the same save as the Voiceover panel's section editor. Uses no credit; undoable. A recorded voice keeps the old words until that part is recorded again (rerecord_narration_section).

tools.name: rerecord_narration_section
tools.description: Record only one part of the narration again, keeping the other parts' audio, the same as re-recording one block in the Voiceover panel. Uses 1 voice generation once approved. The voice stays the recording's voice: to change the voice, record the whole script (request_voiceover_audio). On a Full cont

tools.name: request_voiceover_audio
tools.description: Records the current draft script with an AI voice (Miles, Maya, Grant or Nora). It follows request_voiceover_script or draft_narration, once the person has read the draft (read_narration_script shows its exact words) and chosen a voice. Uses 1 voice generation once approved, and the recording goes i

tools.name: request_download
tools.description: Where the person downloads the video in one format (16:9, 1:1 or 9:16): downloads are made in Reel-E, so this returns the listing page link (and the editor's) for the owner. Nothing renders from this call.

tools.name: create_seller_report_link
tools.description: Create the private seller report page (visit counts only, no names) and its link. It replaces any earlier seller link, which stops working. Needs the person's yes. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

tools.name: enable_mls_link
tools.description: Turns on the hosted MLS video link: a public, unbranded 16:9 page for MLS video fields. Needs the person's yes. get_mls_kit shows the kit first. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

tools.name: publish_website
tools.description: Publish or update the listing website with this video. Needs the person's yes. On a Full control connection it starts at once; otherwise it returns a confirmationId and waits for the owner's yes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_seller_update · Private data: upload_media, add_listing_photos, request_photo_upload, set_listing_basics, update_property_details, set_contact_card, set_headshot, request_voiceover_script, rerecord_narration_section, request_voiceover_audio, create_seller_report_link · Public sink: upload_media, confirm_action, request_photo_upload, get_seller_update, update_property_details, publish_website · Destructive: start_listing, review_revision_notes, suggest_direction, remove_shots, set_shot_length, set_movement, frame_shot, read_music_structure, set_edit_style, trim_music, align_first_cut_to_drop, remove_text, remove_sticker, set_headshot, apply_effect, request_photo_edit, request_download.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_seller_update · Private data: upload_media, add_listing_photos, request_photo_upload, set_listing_basics, update_property_details, set_contact_card, set_headshot, request_voiceover_script, rerecord_narration_section, request_voiceover_audio, create_seller_report_link · Public sink: upload_media, confirm_action, request_photo_upload, get_seller_update, update_property_details, publish_website · Destructive: start_listing, review_revision_notes, suggest_direction, remove_shots, set_shot_length, set_movement, frame_shot, read_music_structure, set_edit_style, trim_music, align_first_cut_to_drop, remove_text, remove_sticker, set_headshot, apply_effect, request_photo_edit, request_download

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
